provenance: Synthetic test fixture: an unverified diagnosis candidate (no code list) for lifecycle and verification tests. Copied from mimic-iv-core 1.4.0 before diabetes became a validated concept.

definition.summary: Diabetes diagnosis attached to the eligible admission
definition.temporal_rule: Confirm whether admission-coded diagnosis represents the intended pre-existing history.
definition.value_rule: Apply a reviewed ICD-9/ICD-10 diabetes code set.
definition.missingness_rule: Absence of a diagnosis code is not automatically equivalent to confirmed absence until the definition is approved.
